title: Almost Persuaded
description: Almost Persuaded in Tonic Solfa to ALMOST PERSUADED: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Philip P. Bliss wrote both the words and the tune ALMOST PERSUADED, published in 1871.
underlay: “Al-most per-suad-ed” now to be-lieve; “Al-most per-suad-ed” Christ to re-ceive; Seems now some soul to say, “Go, Spi-rit, go Thy way, Some more con-ven-ient day On Thee I’ll call.”

lines: Seems now some soul to say,
Prayers rise from hearts so dear;
